summary: MMEX Resources filed an 8-K reporting two items: a debt conversion under Item 3.02 and a permit approval under Item 8.01. The company issued 27,483,541,015 unregistered common shares to consultants and related parties, converting roughly $1.38 million of outstanding consulting obligations into equity under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions, effective October 30, 2026. Separately, project affiliate Pecos UltraClean Refining received TCEQ Permit by Rule approval for the UltraClean Refinery North facility in Pecos County, Texas. Neither is a special situation; watch dilution from the massive share issuance and financing progress on the refinery.
